scripts.text: Your bag is too heavy. Reduce some weight and come back.
scripts.translation: 您的背包太重了。请减轻负重后再来。

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Butler]
Bring Temporal Crystal items for various Temporal boots items. Pick something you want.
scripts.translation:
[胡金的管家]
带来时间结晶，就能兑换各种时空之靴。
请选择您想要的款式。

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: Buy Temporal Boots (Need 1 Temporal Crystal)
scripts.translation: 购买时空之靴（需要1个时间结晶）

scripts.text: Upgrade Temporal Boots (Need 5 Temporal Crystals)
scripts.translation: 升级时空之靴（需要5个时间结晶）

scripts.text: Upgrade Modified Boots (Need 5 Temporal Crystals)
scripts.translation: 升级改造靴（需要5个时间结晶）

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Butler]
Come back whenever you want.
scripts.translation:
[胡金的管家]
随时欢迎您回来。

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Butler]
Take these Temporal Boots. We can upgrade your Temporal Boots with 5 Temporal Crystals.
scripts.translation:
[胡金的管家]
请收下这双时空之靴。您可以使用5个时间结晶来升级您的时空之靴。

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Butler]
You need more Temporal Crystals. Come back when you get some more Temporal Crystals during your travel through Old Glast Heim.
scripts.translation:
[胡金的管家]
时间结晶不够。
请在探索旧格拉斯特海姆时多收集一些，再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Butler]
Only the item you are wearing can be upgraded.
Wear the ^0000FFTemporal Boots^000000 you want to upgrade, and then talk to me once again.
scripts.translation:
[胡金的管家]
我只能升级您身上穿着的装备。
请先穿上要升级的^0000FF时空之靴^000000，再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Butler]
You are not wearing the Temporal Boots. Talk to me once you're wearing them.
scripts.translation:
[胡金的管家]
您没有穿着时空之靴。请穿上后再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Butler]
Not enough Temporal Crystals. You need 5 Temporal Crystals to upgrade your item.
scripts.translation:
[胡金的管家]
时间结晶不足。升级您的物品需要5个时间结晶。

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Butler]
You can trade ^0000FF1 Temporal Boots and 5 Temporal Crystals^000000 for 1 of the following items. ^FF0000Previous refine rate will not be retained with these new ones^000000.
scripts.translation:
[胡金的管家]
用^0000FF1双时空之靴和5个时间结晶^000000，可以兑换下列任意一双靴子。
^FF0000兑换后不会保留原有的精炼等级^000000。

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: Str Boots
scripts.translation: 力量时空之靴

scripts.text: Int Boots
scripts.translation: 智力时空之靴

scripts.text: Agi Boots
scripts.translation: 敏捷时空之靴

scripts.text: Vit Boots
scripts.translation: 体力时空之靴

scripts.text: Dex Boots
scripts.translation: 灵巧时空之靴

scripts.text: Luk Boots
scripts.translation: 幸运时空之靴

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Butler]
Come back anytime you want.
scripts.translation:
[胡金的管家]
随时欢迎您回来。

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Butler]
Are you sure about buying Temporal ^FF0000Strength^000000 Boots? There's no refunds.
scripts.translation:
[胡金的管家]
确定要购买时光^FF0000力量^000000战靴吗？购买后不予退款。

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Butler]
Are you sure about buying Temporal ^FF0000Intelligence^000000 Boots? There's no refunds.
scripts.translation:
[胡金的管家]
确定要购买时光^FF0000智慧^000000战靴吗？购买后不予退款。

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Butler]
Are you sure about buying Temporal ^FF0000Agility^000000 Boots? There's no refunds.
scripts.translation:
[胡金的管家]
确定要购买时光^FF0000敏捷^000000战靴吗？购买后不予退款。

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Butler]
Are you sure about buying Temporal ^FF0000Vitality^000000 Boots? There's no refunds.
scripts.translation:
[胡金的管家]
确定要购买时光^FF0000体质^000000战靴吗？购买后不予退款。

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Butler]
Are you sure about buying Temporal ^FF0000Dexterity^000000 Boots? There's no refunds.
scripts.translation:
[胡金的管家]
确定要购买时光^FF0000灵巧^000000战靴吗？购买后不予退款。

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Butler]
Are you sure about buying Temporal ^FF0000Lucky^000000 Boots? There's no refunds.
scripts.translation:
[胡金的管家]
确定要购买时光^FF0000幸运^000000战靴吗？购买后不予退款。

scripts.text: Think again
scripts.translation: 再考虑一下

scripts.text: Yes, I am sure.
scripts.translation: 是的，我很确定

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Butler]
Ok, come back again when you are sure.
scripts.translation:
[胡金的管家]
好的，等您确定后再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Butler]
The boots have been upgraded as you want.
scripts.translation:
[胡金的管家]
靴子已经按照您的要求升级了。

scripts.text: Your bag is too heavy. Reduce some weight and come back.
scripts.translation: 您的背包太重了。请减轻负重后再来。

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Magician]
So you came to enchant the Temporal Boots. Be aware that Boots with sockets cannot be enchanted, and this upgrade is only possible for the boots you are wearing.
scripts.translation:
[胡金的魔法师]
您是来为时空之靴附魔的吧？
请注意，我只能处理您穿在身上的靴子，已经打孔的靴子无法附魔。

scripts.text: How does the enchanting work?
scripts.translation: 附魔是怎么运作的？

scripts.text: Give effect to my Temporal Boots
scripts.translation: 为时空之靴附魔

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Magician]
You can keep obtain ^0000FFCoagulated Spell^000000 through your travel times.
scripts.translation:
[胡金的魔法师]
您可以在旅行途中不断获得^0000FF凝固的魔力^000000。

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Magician]
I can enchant your Temporal Boots items depands on the amount of that item. ^0000FFNot normal type boots^000000. Only possible for those 6 expanded version boots.
scripts.translation:
[胡金的魔法师]
支付一定数量的材料，我就能为您的时空之靴附魔。
^0000FF普通款不行^000000，只有六种进阶款才能附魔。

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Magician]
But, once you put a socket into the item, you cannot enchant it. Make sure to remember that.
scripts.translation:
[胡金的魔法师]
不过，靴子一旦打孔，我就无法为它附魔了。
请一定记住。

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Magician]
I don't give out effect randomly. You can pick which effect you want for the item.
scripts.translation:
[胡金的魔法师]
我不会随机赋予效果。您可以选择想要赋予物品的效果。

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Magician]
Of course it is for 4th slot only. You can have small effect at the start, and then the effect gets stronger.
scripts.translation:
[胡金的魔法师]
当然，能自选效果的只有第4个插槽。
最初的效果较弱，之后可以逐步强化。

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Magician]
To get to the final option upgrade, it will require way more Coagulated Spell items. Don't forget that.
scripts.translation:
[胡金的魔法师]
要把附魔属性提升到最高级，需要更多凝固的魔力，别忘了。

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Magician]
Once the 4th slot completes the best option, you get to have a random bonus effect to the 3rd slot. With.. certain payment~
scripts.translation:
[胡金的魔法师]
第4个插槽的属性升到最高级后，还能为第3个插槽添加随机的额外效果。
当然...要付点费用~

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Magician]
Also, you don't lose the item even if the enchant fails, we also guarantee keeping card and refine rate. But we can't initialize enchanting.
scripts.translation:
[胡金的魔法师]
即使附魔失败，装备也不会消失，卡片和精炼等级同样会保留。
不过，我无法重置附魔。

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Magician]
Phew...
Anyways, that's all for basic enchant information. Now you should see for yourself.
scripts.translation:
[胡金的魔法师]
呼...基本的附魔知识就说到这里，接下来亲自体验吧。

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Magician]
Are you wearing the item?
scripts.translation:
[胡金的魔法师]
您身上穿着这件物品吗？

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Magician]
These boots have already passed the enchanting limit. We can't enchant them any more.
scripts.translation:
[胡金的魔法师]
这双靴子已经达到附魔上限了。我们无法再对其进行附魔。

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Magician]
Want to enchant ^0000FF{0}^000000?
For the 1st enchanting, you need ^0000FF1^000000 Coagulated Spell items.
scripts.translation:
[胡金的魔法师]
要为^0000FF{0}^000000附魔吗？
首次附魔需要^0000FF1^000000个凝结魔力。

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text: Fighting Spirit
scripts.translation: 斗志

scripts.text: Archery
scripts.translation: 名弓

scripts.text: Spell
scripts.translation: 咒语

scripts.text: Vitality
scripts.translation: 体力

scripts.text: Attack Speed
scripts.translation: 攻击速度

scripts.text: Lucky
scripts.translation: 幸运

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Magician]
Ok, come back when you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[胡金的魔法师]
好的，准备好了再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Magician]
Enchanting ^0000FF{0}^000000's 4th slot as ^0000FF2^000000 level effect. Requires ^0000FF{1}^000000 Coagulated Spell items.

[Hugin's Magician]
Enchanting ^0000FF{0}^000000's 4th slot as ^0000FF3^000000 level effect. Requires ^0000FF{1}^000000 Coagulated Spell items.
Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text: Effect Upgrade!
scripts.translation: 升级效果

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Magician]
Ok, come back when you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[胡金的魔法师]
好的，准备好了再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Magician]
Hmm, you are missing {0} Coagulated Spell items. Go get more, and then we can talk about more enchants.
scripts.translation:
[胡金的魔法师]
嗯，您还差{0}个凝固的魔力。
凑齐以后，再来附魔吧。

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Magician]
Trying for enchant number ^6300001^000000.
scripts.translation:
[胡金的魔法师]
正在尝试第^6300001^000000次附魔。

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Magician]
Trying for enchant number ^6300002^000000.
scripts.translation:
[胡金的魔法师]
正在尝试第^6300002^000000次附魔。

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Magician]
Trying for enchant number ^6300003^000000.
scripts.translation:
[胡金的魔法师]
正在尝试第^6300003^000000次附魔。

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Magician]
This is not the right item for this enchant.
Remember, only those 6 types of Temporal Boots are available for enchanting.
scripts.translation:
[胡金的魔法师]
这件装备不符合附魔条件。
请记住，只有那六种时空之靴才能附魔。

scripts.text: Your bag is too heavy. Reduce some weight and come back.
scripts.translation: 您的背包太重了。请减轻负重后再来。

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Craftsman]
That Magician always says that enchanting Temporal Boots is the best. But, I think quite different.
scripts.translation:
[胡金的工匠]
那个魔法师总说时空之靴还是附魔好，我可不这么想。

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Craftsman]
I think putting a slot into the item would be the best. Even with some risk of failing.
scripts.translation:
[胡金的工匠]
我觉得打孔才是最好的选择，哪怕有点失败风险。

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Craftsman]
Bring me ^0000FF5 Temporal Crystals^000000, and I will try to put a slot into your advanced Temporal Boots. But, it's possible to ^FF0000fail and break the item^000000. Is that ok?
scripts.translation:
[胡金的工匠]
给我^0000FF5个时间结晶^000000，我就尝试为你的进阶时空之靴打孔。
不过，可能会^FF0000失败，导致装备损坏^000000。
能接受吗？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: Take the risk and try to add a slot
scripts.translation: 冒险尝试打孔

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Craftsman]
Ok, come back anytime you want.
scripts.translation:
[胡金的工匠]
好的，随时欢迎回来。

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Craftsman]
Are you sure you are wearing the item?
scripts.translation:
[胡金的工匠]
你确定你穿着这件物品吗？

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Craftsman]
And ^FF0000all enchant or refine rates will be lost if you fail this.^000000
Still want to risk it?
scripts.translation:
[胡金的工匠]
而且，^FF0000如果失败，所有附魔或精炼等级都会丢失。^000000
还要冒险吗？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: I am ok with it!
scripts.translation: 我接受！

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Craftsman]
Once again, ^FF0000That Magician won't enchant any item with a slot.^000000
Still want to proceed?
scripts.translation:
[胡金的工匠]
再说一次，^FF0000那个魔法师不会附魔任何带有插槽的物品。^000000
还要继续吗？

scripts.text: I understand. Try to slot it.
scripts.translation: 我明白，开始打孔

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Craftsman]
Ok, come back anytime you want.
scripts.translation:
[胡金的工匠]
好的，随时欢迎回来。

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Craftsman]
You must bring ^0000FF5 Temporal Crystal items^000000. Nothing is free you know...
scripts.translation:
[胡金的工匠]
你需要携带^0000FF5个时间结晶^000000。天下没有免费的午餐，你知道的...

scripts.text:
[Hugin's Craftsman]
Arrggg, we failed. Better luck next time.
scripts.translation:

祝你下次好运吧。
